connector.name: Bankruptcy Observer
connector.registryDescription: US business bankruptcy MCP: filings, dockets, documents, case summaries. Free tier + subscription.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.bankruptcyobserver.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.bankruptcyobserver. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer MCP API token for subscriber tools. Optional for free-tier lookups. X-API-Key also supported.
